text:
Rina: Vespera go-live scheduled Thu 08:00 PT. They've committed 60k tokens/min. Quick sync: quota validate, autoscale policy tune, shadow load + 30m canary, enablement + renewal risk ask. Who's in?

Omar: I'll verify quota mapping and check provider egress. Last-minute ISP throttles bit us before.

Holly: I'll own autoscale. Initial suggestion: policy 'latency-first' with min_nodes=4, scale_step=+2, scale_up on CPU>62% or queue>220, cooldown 40s.

AutoscaleBot: [09:04] policy-sim: 'latency-first' sim 20m -> projected meet at 60k, median scale latency 38s.

Samir: I'll run shadow load. Mix: 75% short prompts, 25% long context. Using `hey` for simple POSTs and `wrk` for streaming paths. Example short test:

```
hey -c 250 -q 40 -z 12m -m POST -d '{"input":"short prompt"}' https://staging.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

Expect ~2.4k rps for short path.

Rina: SLA targets: P95 short <120ms, P95 long <320ms, error budget <=0.25%. Also capture cost forecast for month-1 (they're worried about overrun).

Omar: Provider shows default egress 25Gbps. I asked Vespera infra to raise to 80Gbps, ticket opened w/ ETA 36h. Sharing test endpoints privately.

Holly: Shadow1 results (brief): sustained 55k tokens/min, P95 short=115ms, P95 long=385ms (high), 5xx=0.04%. Autoscale added nodes as expected, batch util ~68%. Logs: https://logs.internal/vespera/5109876543/shadow1

Samir: Long-path latency is the blocker. I'll run shadow2 with `kv_prefetch` and reduced batch for long requests.

AutoscaleBot: [09:35] canary-create: 3% route for model 'redwood-vespera-prod'. Monitors: latency, errors, cpu, queue-depth. Auto-rollback set at 0.5% 5xx over 5m.

Holly: Config tweak to try:

```
model_config:\n  batch_max_tokens: 3072\n  kv_prefetch: true\n  quant_profile: perf
```

Apply only for requests tagged long=true.

Nate: CSM note: renewal risk flagged. Vespera wants a conservative 90-day forecast + a low-cost fallback plan. FinanceBot, can we get template?

FinanceBot: [09:48] finance-note: uploaded forecast_template.xlsx to shared drive. Need token-per-endpoint sampling from CSM.

Samir: Shadow2 started with kv_prefetch + reduced batch. Will post concise results.

Omar: Quick infra test: egress bump confirmed to 80Gbps in ticket but not yet live. If not live by EOD, we should delay cutover 48h.

Samir: Shadow2 quick results: sustained 57k tokens/min, P95 short=112ms, P95 long=270ms (nice), 5xx=0.03%. Autoscale stable. Logs: https://logs.internal/vespera/5109876543/shadow2

Holly: Looks good. Suggest during golden hour set scale-in cooldown to 5m to avoid oscillations and enable tracing for first 48h.

Rina: Owners: Omar=quota & infra, Holly=autoscale + runbook, Samir=load tests + logs, Nate=CSM + renewal cadence, Rina=program owner.

Nate: I'll schedule a 30m enablement Wed 11:00 PT. We'll record + run short demo (routing, fallback to redwood-lite, cost controls). I'll also ask Vespera app owners for 3 sample prompts that cause long contexts.

Holly: Rollback plan: auto-rollback to `redwood-lite` if 5xx >0.6% for 10m OR P95 short >250ms for 5m. Confirm?

Rina: Confirmed. Also add a manual abort if egress shows packet drops >0.1% sustained.

AutoscaleBot: [10:12] shadow-monitor: shadow2 shows no autoscale errors, scale events normal.

Omar: Egress now live at 80Gbps. Posting final infra note.

Rina: Great. Final asks: Samir upload a 5-min shadow highlight clip for enablement, Holly post the runbook snippet, Nate prepare the renewal forecast start. If anything blocks, hold cutover. Reconvene tomorrow 09:00 PT for final greenlight. :thumbsup:
